playtester.description: Runs bulk fight simulations, tests fight week flow, and analyzes balance for MMA Life Simulator

reviewer.description: Reviews Python + JS code for MMA Life Simulator, enforces stdlib-only, frontend patterns, and project conventions

game-analyst.description: Analyzes game data via the SQLite database. Use when checking balance, fighter stats, promotions, or career progression.

frontend-debugger.description: Uses Playwright MCP to screenshot and interact with the MMA Life UI, catching CSS layout bugs and JS errors

e2e-tester.description: Runs end-to-end API flows: create fighter -> book -> fight week -> full multi-round fight -> results

fight-engine-tuner.description: Runs 500+ bulk fight sims, analyzes KO/SUB/DEC rates by archetype, and suggests combat.json parameter changes

save-validator.description: Validates SQLite database integrity, checks schema consistency, finds orphaned records and corruption patterns

performance-profiler.description: Profiles CPU time and memory of fight sim, day advance, and world sim. Detects slow paths and memory leaks

config-designer.description: Analyzes combat.json balance vs real UFC target rates, suggests parameter changes with predicted outcome shifts

seed-fuzzer.description: Tests game determinism: same seed x3 -> identical outcomes. Tests N seeds to validate distribution expectations

ui-designer.description: Analyzes and improves the MMA Life frontend UI — layout, CSS, responsive design, component structure, and gameflow UX

gameflow-analyzer.description: Traces the full player journey through the game, finds broken flows, missing feedback, stale state, and UX dead ends

game-tester.description: Full gameplay testing: plays through complete careers (10+ fights), tests all subsystems, finds bugs and balance issues

playtest.description: Run bulk fight simulations to verify game balance
playtest.template: Start the web server, run /api/bulk_simulate with count=500, analyze KO/submission/decision rates per archetype matchup, and report balance findings.

game-analyze.description: Run game data analysis reports on the SQLite database
game-analyze.template: Run the save-validator agent on the database, then query SQLite for promotion health, fighter distributions, and ranking anomalies. Summarize key findings.

test-all.description: Run the full testing suite: reviewer + unittest + fight-engine-tuner + frontend-debugger + e2e-tester + save-validator + performance-profiler
test-all.template: Run the complete testing infrastructure. 1) reviewer on recent git diff for code quality. 2) python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v. 3) fight-engine-tuner for 500 sim balance check. 4) Start server, run frontend-debugger for UI smoke test. 5) Run e2e-tester for full fight week flow. 6) Run save-validator on database. 7) Run performance-profiler baseline. Produce a comprehensive report.

gametest.description: Run the game-tester agent for comprehensive gameplay testing (careers, balance, edge cases)
gametest.template: Start the web server, then run the game-tester agent to play through 5+ full fight careers, testing all subsystems (training, finance, promotions, titles, injuries, retirement). Report every bug and balance issue found.

uidesign.description: Run the UI designer to overhaul the frontend (modals, CSS, tabs, loading states, animations, mobile)
uidesign.template: Read .opencode/agents/ui-designer.md for the full checklist. Then open templates/index.html and implement ALL remaining items: loading states on every button, error handling (replace empty catch blocks), tab navigation transitions, mobile responsive fixes, and health bar animations. Verify with Playwright screenshots.
